summary: On the main deck, several people gasp in reaction to something they are watching off-screen (the fight in the dojo). Mouse voices disbelief, exclaiming that he doesn't believe what he is seeing. The scene captures the observers' stunned reaction to the fight's outcome.

what_changes.before: Watching the fight from the main deck, impressed by Neo's speed
what_changes.after: Reacting with disbelief to Neo landing a blow on Morpheus
what_changes.evidence: There are several gasps. MOUSE I don't believe it!

event_hint.one_line: The crew on the main deck react with gasps and disbelief as Neo lands a blow on Morpheus.
